findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Inspector observed an employee shutting the faucet off without the use of a barrier. Education was carried out. Discussed with PIC. The behavior was corrected. Ensure that proper handwashing procedures ares followed appropriately.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: The handwashing sink at the front of the kitchen was observed obstructed by a cardboard box filled with other boxes. Discussed with PIC. The box was removed providing access to the hand sink. Ensure that all handwashing sinks within the facility are accessible at all times to promote proper handwashing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The concentration of the sanitizer in the triple sink in the back was measured at 0ppm. Discussed with PIC and the sanitizer was remade and tested at 300ppm. Ensure that the concentration of all sanitizers within the facility are monitored, tested, and changed at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Food properly labeled; original container.
findings.comment: Three containers of white powder were observed to be stored under the prep table.Discussed with PIC and the containers were labeled appropriately. Ensure that all secondary containers used for storage are labeled appropriately. [C]
findings.citation_text: 3-302.12 Food Storage Containers, Identified with Common Name of Food. Except for containers holding FOOD that can be readily and unmistakably recognized such as dry pasta, working containers holding FOOD or FOOD ingredients that are removed from their original packages for use in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, such as cooking oils, flour, herbs, potato flakes, salt, spices, and sugar shall be identified with the common name of the FOOD.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: A mop head was observed to be stored improperly. Discussed with Person In Charge and the mop storage was corrected. Ensure that the adequate mop storage is used to avoid the growth of bacteria culture. [C]
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The caulking on the hand sink tab the back of the kitchen was observed to be coming off the wall. PIC was made aware. Ensure that the caulking is redone providing access to smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment:
The following items were observed to be stored improperly.
1. A jug of barbecue sauce made by Little Caesar was labeled to be refrigerated after opening was observed to be stored under the prep table.
2. Several bottles of Parmesan cheese were observed to be stored underneath the pizza prep table by the prep cooler. The packet of the Parmesan chess was labeled “refrigerate after opening” as a result of milk being a major ingredient. 
PIC was made aware and the jug of barbecue sauce was tossed in the trash. The Parmesan cheese was placed in the refrigerator as had been opened for less than 3 hours.
Ensure that label instructions of food items are carefully followed to avoid contamination. [P]
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.comment: A personal drink in a single used beverage container was observed to be store in the standing freezer by the prep table. PIC was made aware of the personal drink storage and the drink was taken away. Ensure that storage location for person items are designated to avoid contamination. [C]
findings.citation_text: 6-403.11(B) Designated Areas. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be located in a designated room or area where contamination of FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLESERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES can not occur.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
5-205.15: Today’s re-inspect was to ensure repairs had been made to the walk-in cooler drain and the drain pipe of the triple sink. The walk-in cooler drain is observed to be slowly draining and the triple sink has had no repairs to the drip that takes place. An additional follow-up is being scheduled for 6/14/2024 on these items. 
5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The green drying racks for the dishes is observed with an accumulation of soil/grease that is in contact with the utensils. Ensure this green shelving is cleaned and sanitized  to remove the current accumulation and then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain it clean. A follow-up will take place on 6-14-24 to observe this item. 
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The following areas were observed with an accumulation of food debris/soils:
-Beside the pizza prep station where the boxes are stored has food debris accumulation.
-The fan cages of the walk-in cooler have dust accumulation.
-The Air intakes of the pizza warmers have dust accumulation. 
Ensure these areas are cleaned to remove the current accumulation of food debris/soils and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
5-205.15: The following areas are in need of repair by a licensed plumber:
-The drain pipes under the triple sink are observed with a leak when water is ran.
-The floor drain for the walk-in cooler is observed not draining and will need to be repaired to be able to drain.
Ensure these plumbing areas are repaired by a licensed plumber to make the floor drain drain properly and the triple sink drain pipe to not leak. 
5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
Not all employees have a valid food handlers. Ensure that employees acquire a food handler certificate within 30 days of hire and have these records readily available in the facility for review. 
410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: At the start of the inspection, the QUAT dispenser at the triple sink was tested utilizing appropriate test strips and was recorded at 0ppm. After trouble shooting, it was recognized that the dispenser tubing had been crushed under the metal holding shelf under the sink. After removing the shelf unit and freeing the tubing from its crushed nature, the sanitizer dispenser worked as required and was retested and recorded at 200ppm QUAT. Ensure after cleaning that the tubing is free of obstruction and ensure testing is performed regularly to have confidence in the sanitizing solution.
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: General equipment surfaces on the bottom shelves and walls near the high traffic/prep areas are observed with surface soil of flour, sauce, crumbs, etc. Ensure during routine cleaning that the items on shelving are moved aside to allow for a complete clean of the equipment being used. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.
